backward_compat_traps.rule: eSPI multiplexes 4 logical channels with a command/response + turnaround protocol; it is NOT a NOR-flash SPI (single MOSI/MISO read/write).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Decoding eSPI as classic SPI (no channels, no VW/OOB/Flash, no CRC negotiation) is wrong.

backward_compat_traps.rule: eSPI is the LPC successor — it tunnels LPC-style I/O, memory and DMA cycles plus sideband signals in-band.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating eSPI as unrelated to LPC misses the Virtual Wire sideband tunneling intent.

lineage.summary: Low Pin Count bus — the predecessor eSPI replaces.
Adds Quad I/O at 66 MHz, refined Virtual Wire indices.
